verdict.rationale: The manual states outright that "Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!". It documents many concrete hotkeys: Super+Ctrl+V for the Walker clipboard history, Super+Ctrl+R for reminders, Super+Ctrl+PrtScr for OCR and Super+Ctrl+X for dictation. System tasks such as installs, themes and terminals run through the Omarchy Menu, and switching terminals keeps the same keyboard shortcuts working. Missing for 10: documentation of the launcher itself and of window-management hotkeys (the evidence only mentions Walker for clipboard and never says how the Omarchy Menu is opened), and independent hands-on confirmation that keyboard-only operation works in practice.
